summary: Because UnifiedMarketStateEngine has an empty vol_models dictionary at runtime, all three horizons (1h, 4h, 24h) fall back to the exact same scalar value: the trailing 12-bar (1h) realized volatility scaled by sqrt(288). Consequently, the model's incremental predictive value over a simple trailing realized volatility persistence baseline is EXACTLY 0.00000 across all horizons. The observed positive correlations at 1h (0.5410) and 4h (0.4519) reflect well-known financial market volatility clustering (autoregression) inherent in BTC price action, NOT proprietary machine learning edge.

1h.incremental_scientific_value: ZERO_OVER_PERSISTENCE (Model is physically identical to trailing 1h realized vol)
1h.causal_mechanism: PERSISTENCE_ONLY (Vol clustering, no ML incremental alpha)
